expectations.text: OCR is placed before canonical source-text persistence, not only in a UI preview.
expectations.evidence: Response places OCR after HTML cleanup and before article_info.body_text cache persistence, then traces it into summary, search, Q&A, and reports.

expectations.text: The solution uses bounded concurrency and preserves original DOM order.
expectations.evidence: Response uses a maximum of five workers, executor.map/recognize_many_ordered, and explicitly mutates the DOM in source order.

expectations.text: The token is not returned by GET endpoints or exposed in source/logs.
expectations.evidence: Response specifies a password PUT flow, owner-only local storage, GET status-only output, and excludes the token from logs, metadata, exports, and tests.

expectations.text: Daily and weekly reports use the complete enriched article body rather than a short summary excerpt.
expectations.evidence: Response requires wechat_reports._source_material to load the complete enriched source text and rejects use of a summary or fixed-length excerpt.

suggestions.reason: All assertions passed in both configurations. The next eval should target cache idempotency and partial OCR failure, where a generic plan is less likely to specify an actionable invariant.

eval_feedback.overall: Core assertions are valid but not sufficiently discriminating on their own.
